title: UX on time zone picker is the worst
body: The app is basically unusable if you’re trying to set up a meeting in a time zone that’s not your. How in the world am I supposed to find a timezone if they’re all over the place?! Putting them in aplhabetical order based on countries, not on names? How about you put them from GMT-10 to GTM+10? Or just let me search for a city, come on. I’m not scrolling endlessly to find the one I need.

body: The calendar works great for scheduling appointments and events, but I think it could be improved with one simple change - why not make the calendar icon display the actual day of the month instead of the number 31? Hope you fix this.
